fusions.name: Driven Sand
fusions.desc: A blast of blown sand that deals 8 damage and leaves the target 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges; a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Scouring Front
fusions.desc: Drives a storm of sand and scree through a cone 5 tiles long that deals 28 damage to everything in it, plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, and leaves them [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Billowing Grit
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, grit whirls round you and 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Scree Kite
fusions.desc: A bonded gargoyle of stone flies beside you, striking enemies within 5 tiles for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it strikes moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
